one_liner: Linear has a broad GraphQL API with self-serve OAuth2 and personal API keys on the free plan, plus an official hosted MCP server, so a toolkit is ready to build.
auth_notes: OAuth2 authorization-code flow, with optional actor=app and client-credentials tokens. Personal API keys are also available (lin_api_...). Refresh tokens are in use for all OAuth apps.
access_notes: Free plan is $0 with unlimited members. One third-party source says the API is included in all plans, including free. OAuth apps can be created in settings. Admins can restrict member API key creation.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Rate limits apply, and higher limits are available on request.

evidence.quote: Linear supports OAuth2 authentication, which is recommended if you’re building applications to integrate with Linear.
For personal scripts API keys are the easiest way to access the API.
Yes, API access included in all plans including free tier (unlimited users).
The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
Read-write access is provided through `https://mcp.linear.app/mcp` by default.
